meta.title: Trubbo: a trivia quiz you play out loud
meta.description: Trubbo is a trivia quiz for iPhone. It reads every question aloud and you answer out loud. In English, Slovak and Czech.
suggest.text: This page is also in English.
hero.title: A quiz nobody has to read out.
hero.lead: Trubbo reads the questions aloud and listens for your answers. This is how one quiz goes.
s0.title: Pick categories and a language.
s0.body: History, sports, science, food and more. Play in English, Slovak or Czech, and set an age level so kids can play along.
s1.title: Trubbo reads the question aloud.
s1.body: Everyone hears it at once, including whoever is driving or cooking. Nobody has to look at the phone.
s2.title: You answer out loud.
s2.body: Just say it. When you can't talk, type the answer, or tap it when there are options.
s3.title: Meaning counts, not exact wording.
s3.body: “None at all, I think” counts too. AI judges the answer by what it means, not by the exact words. Every question has a checked source.
s4.title: Then the next question.
s4.body: After each answer you hear whether it was right, and the next question follows.
s5.title: See how it went.
s5.body: Every quiz ends with your score. If you'd rather hear the answers only at the end, you can then go back over each question: your answer, the right one and its source.
